129688.overview: Willy owns a lavish mansion with over 60 rooms linked in a 3D plane, and must tidy it all before his housekeeper will let him sleep. Each room has its own hazards, such as spikes, revolving razors and ropes. The route through the house must be navigated carefully, due to the multiple entrances to some rooms - this is perhaps the first action game where mapping is an advantage.

450932.overview: A conversion of the game Jet Set Miner on the BBC Micro to the Acorn Atom.

450937.overview: Acorn Atom conversion of the David Boddie version on the BBC Micro / Acorn Electron The player must help the character reach the exit for each level. However, the player must first find a key to unlock the exit
